Structural drift: layout differs from the RSR template's directory map.

This repository pins GitHub Actions through .github/workflows/actions.lock (generated by `gh actions-lock`), which is the mechanism adopted in #16/#18 to end the estate-wide startup_failure outage. The lockfile records each action by tag and resolves it to a SHA at run time, so the workflows are pinned even though `uses:` lines show tags. Applying this rule's remediation literally -- rewriting `uses:` to inline SHAs -- REMOVES those actions from the lockfile's view and has been demonstrated elsewhere in this estate to cause startup_failure across every workflow touched. The finding is therefore a false positive against a lockfile-pinned repository, and acting on it would be a regression. Revisit if the scorecard rule becomes lockfile-aware.
